summary: Targeted bug-fix verification for the Google Maps 'Geocoder is not a constructor' crash. Verified that /taxi (TaxiHubPage) and /course?mode=standard (RideChoosePage) load cleanly, render correctly, and never throw the constructor error. Geocoder access is now centralized through the new getGeocoder() helper in src/lib/googleMaps.js (direct constructor + importLibrary('geocoding') fallback), and all 4 listed consumers (TaxiHubPage, RideChoosePage, MapLocationPicker, TaxiHallModal) route through it.

regression_checks.taxi_hub_loads: PASS - title 'Choisissez un service' rendered, 6 mode tiles visible (Taxi VTC, Pool-partage, Moto Taxi, Electric, Planifiez votre trajet, Mise a Dispo, etc.). No error overlay.
regression_checks.taxi_geolocate_no_crash: PASS - no dedicated locate button on /taxi; navigation to the page already triggers reverse-geocode internally and did not crash.
regression_checks.course_standard_loads: PASS - 'Taxi VTC' heading + departure card + 'Utiliser ma position actuelle' button render.
regression_checks.course_locate_button_no_crash: PASS - clicking data-testid='ride-choose-locate' (geolocation granted, Paris 48.8566,2.3522) populated DEPART with '4 Pl. de l'Hotel de Ville, 75004 Paris, France' - reverse-geocode succeeded via getGeocoder(). No overlay, no constructor error.
regression_checks.map_location_picker: NOT TESTED - no 'Definir sur la carte' entry point reachable from /taxi in current build (lower priority).
regression_checks.console_constructor_errors: PASS - 0 occurrences of 'is not a constructor' across /taxi and /course flows.
regression_checks.error_overlay_iframe: PASS - 0 sightings of react-error-overlay / webpack-dev-server-client-overlay iframe across the entire flow.

critical_code_review_comments: getGeocoder() helper is correctly async and resilient: direct constructor first, falls back to importLibrary('geocoding'), returns null otherwise - good defensive pattern.

All Geocoder consumers (TaxiHubPage L103, RideChoosePage L176/L242, MapLocationPicker L33, TaxiHallModal L56) confirmed routing through getGeocoder() via grep; no remaining 'new google.maps.Geocoder' call sites in the listed files.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified end-to-end. If you need to also cover MapLocationPicker, look for an entry point (e.g., 'Definir sur la carte' / 'Choisir sur la carte') on /course/* address inputs - it was not reachable from /taxi directly. Geolocation must be granted to the origin and a coordinate set (Paris 48.8566,2.3522 works) to exercise the reverse-geocode path.
